$comment: Machine-readable mirror of specification/v0.4/conformance.md. The Markdown document is normative; this catalog only assigns stable rule identifiers so validators can report which requirement an issue violates. tests/test_conformance_catalogs.py keeps the two in sync.
claim_template: Aligned with AI Operations Specification v0.4-draft as observed on {date}.

check_kinds.schema: Decidable by validating the artifact against the schema selected by artifact_type.
check_kinds.semantic: Decidable from the artifact alone with the graph and identity checks this document lists.
check_kinds.process: A behavioral obligation on the implementation; it cannot be decided by inspecting one artifact.

rules.requirement: Emit an artifact that validates against the schema selected by artifact_type.
Preserve globally unique object identities within a Run artifact.
Preserve unique relationship and event identities.
Ensure an end timestamp does not precede its start timestamp.
Resolve every non-external relationship endpoint to an object in the artifact with the declared type.
Contain every Step in its Run exactly once.
Connect every runtime occurrence to exactly one Step using observed-in.
Give every Evaluation at least one evaluates target.
Support workflow_id with a matching run-of relationship.
Ensure event targets resolve with the declared object type.
Reject self-relationships and cycles in structural, causal, and ordering graphs.
When representing retries, preserve distinct occurrence identities for each attempt and link each retry attempt to the prior attempt with an explicit recoverability edge such as follows or caused.
An external reference MUST set external: true.
External resolution is the consumer's responsibility and MUST NOT be reported as verified unless it was resolved.
Perform schema and semantic validation before treating an artifact as aligned.
Interpret structural validity as factual accuracy.
Reject an artifact that contains a value outside a closed vocabulary rather than guessing its meaning (decision D-004).
